name: nika-pocket-listing-ingest-service
description: Independent background service: ingests new WhatsApp messages from the 'Secondary Nika Estate' pocket-listing group, classifies+extracts supply-side listing data via an LLM, and writes Dubai-only NEEDS_REVIEW stock rows into matching_dubai.stock_inventory. No lead-matching logic -- stock supply extraction only (ADR-050).

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
